article.headline: Raptors and Nets meet Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.description: Brooklyn Nets (4-13, 14th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Toronto Raptors (6-11, 10th in the Eastern Conference)
article.title: Raptors and Nets meet Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.linkText: Raptors and Nets meet Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.story: Brooklyn Nets (4-13, 14th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Toronto Raptors (6-11, 10th in the Eastern Conference) Toronto; Friday, 7:30 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: The Toronto Raptors play the Brooklyn Nets in an NBA Cup in-season tournament group play matchup. The Raptors are 0-4 against division opponents. Toronto is 3-8 against opponents over .500. The Nets are 3-10 against Eastern Conference opponents. Brooklyn gives up 118.9 points to opponents and has been outscored by 8.1 points per game. The Raptors average 111.5 points per game, 7.4 fewer points than the 118.9 the Nets allow. The Nets average 14.3 made 3-pointers per game this season, 1.7 more made shots on average than the 12.6 per game the Raptors allow. TOP PERFORMERS: Ja'Kobe Walter is scoring 12.1 points per game and averaging 4.1 rebounds for the Raptors. Immanuel Quickley is averaging 13.6 points and 2.5 rebounds over the last 10 games. Day'Ron Sharpe is shooting 54.1% and averaging 8.9 points for the Nets. Michael Porter Jr. is averaging 2.3 made 3-pointers over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Raptors: 2-8, averaging 106.2 points, 38.4 rebounds, 27.2 assists, 7.9 steals and 4.7 blocks per game while shooting 45.6% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 111.8 points per game. Nets: 3-7, averaging 114.4 points, 39.7 rebounds, 26.3 assists, 8.2 steals and 4.2 blocks per game while shooting 47.4% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 122.2 points. INJURIES: Raptors: Kawhi Leonard: out (knee), Nate Bittle: out (foot), RJ Barrett: out (hamstring). Nets: Nolan Traore: out (hamstring), Moritz Wagner: day to day (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
